messages:
maya (release): Heads-up: ship window in ~4h. We need a tiny preflight: version bump, one-line changelog, security quick-check, and QA gate. Who's taking what?

alex (infra): I can handle the version bump PR. Planning to push `v0.22.1` tag and update `go.mod` today. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:

sam (qa): I'll run the smoke suite once the build is available. ETA ~1.5h. Any new flaky tests I should be aware of?

maya (release): No new flakes reported. Main thing: the memory-regression fix landed on staging — please pay attention to perf counters.

jen (docs): I'll add a short changelog blurb (one sentence) and a docs note for the minor behavior change. Dropping the PR link here when ready.

luke (security): Quick request: run the dependency scan and confirm no new high/critical vuln. I can do a quick manual review if the scanner flags anything.

security-bot: Dependency scan completed: 0 critical, 1 high (dev dependency). See https://ci.example.com/reports/dep-scan/1876543200

luke (security): I looked at the high; it's a test-only tooling dep, no runtime impact. Marking as acceptable for this release.

alex (infra): PR opened: `github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4122` — bumped to `v0.22.1`, updated changelog draft in PR description. CI green except the flaky integration timeout (known).

sam (qa): Kicked off smoke run against that build. Failing test `cache_eviction_test` — looks like intermittent. Re-running. :eyes:

sam (qa): Re-run passed. No blocking failures. Recording in QA checklist.

jen (docs): Changelog blurb added in PR body and in `CHANGELOG.md` in the release folder. Quick link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4122/files#diff-...

maya (release): All right. Security ✅ (luke), QA ✅ (sam), Docs ✅ (jen). Alex — can you merge and push the tag after a 15-minute quiet period?

alex (infra): Will wait 15m, then merge and `git tag -a v0.22.1 -m "v0.22.1"` + push. Planning to trigger canary via `deploy-bot`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: cluster=staging-canary, version=v0.22.1, start=1876543410

maya (release): Thanks team. If anyone spots regressions in canary, post here with logs. Otherwise we'll proceed to full rollout at +30m. :shipit:
